name: spryker-community/inspector
description: Inspector APM integration for Spryker: request, console and AI prompt monitoring.

suggest.propel/propel: Required to report database statements as Inspector segments.
suggest.spryker/ai-foundation: Required to report AI prompts and tool calls as Inspector segments.

suggest.twig/twig: Required to report rendered templates as Inspector segments.
